summary: Shows sample group_vars for a location and a function, defaults in group_vars/all, host-specific values in host_vars, notes dynamic inventory groups like ec2_tag_class_webserver, and that hostvars only exposes host variables.
questions: Where do I put default values that apply to all hosts?
How do I set different NTP servers per data center?
How do I set a variable for just one host?
Can I use group_vars with cloud tag groups from dynamic inventory?

answer_card.title: Sample group and host variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
# group_vars/atlanta
ntp: ntp-atlanta.example.com
backup: backup-atlanta.example.com

# group_vars/webservers
apacheMaxRequestsPerChild: 3000
apacheMaxClients: 900

# group_vars/all  (defaults)
ntp: ntp-boston.example.com
backup: backup-boston.example.com

# host_vars/db-bos-1.example.com
foo_agent_port: 86
bar_agent_port: 99
```

Dynamic inventory creates groups automatically, so a tag `class:webserver` loads `group_vars/ec2_tag_class_webserver`. The `hostvars` variable only reaches host-specific variables, not group variables.
